english: man is a wolf to man

terms.gloss: man is a wolf to man
evidence: Plaut. Asin. 495: lupus est homō hominī, nōn homō, quom quālis sit nōn nōvit
terms.comment: The source of the later homō hominī lupus. In Plautus it is a reason for not lending money to a stranger: a man is a wolf to another man “when he does not know what he is like”.

phrases.latin: lupus est homō hominī, nōn homō, quom quālis sit nōn nōvit
phrases.english: a man is a wolf to a man, not a man, when he doesn’t know what sort he is

sources: Lewis & Short: lupus
